name: Idea to Storyboard to Video
description: Carry a pitched idea through a shot-by-shot storyboard, Firefly-generated storyboard frames, and Firefly-animated video, with a human final review before delivery.

tasks.name: Storyboard Scriptwriter
tasks.objective: Break the pitched idea into a shot-by-shot storyboard script: shot count, framing, camera move, action, and duration for each shot, plus the overall visual style and tone that must hold across every shot.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Break the pitched idea into a shot-by-shot storyboard script: shot count, framing, camera move, action, and duration for each shot, plus the overall visual style and tone that must hold across every shot.

tasks.name: Firefly Storyboard Frames
tasks.objective: Send the shot list and style guide to Adobe Firefly to generate one storyboard frame image per shot, each depicting the specified framing, action, and camera move in the fixed visual style.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Send the shot list and style guide to Adobe Firefly to generate one storyboard frame image per shot, each depicting the specified framing, action, and camera move in the fixed visual style.

tasks.name: Firefly Video Animation
tasks.objective: Send the ordered storyboard frames and per-shot timing to Adobe Firefly's video generation to animate and render each shot in sequence into a single assembled video that matches the storyboard's shot order, framing, and duration.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Send the ordered storyboard frames and per-shot timing to Adobe Firefly's video generation to animate and render each shot in sequence into a single assembled video that matches the storyboard's shot order, framing, and duration.

tasks.name: Production Final Reviewer
tasks.objective: Watch the assembled video against the storyboard script. Reject and request targeted re-render of any shot whose framing, action, timing, or style drifted from the storyboard; approve only a cut that matches the approved shot list.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Watch the assembled video against the storyboard script. Reject and request targeted re-render of any shot whose framing, action, timing, or style drifted from the storyboard; approve only a cut that matches the approved shot list.
